result_text:
I changed the remainder so the "Undefined Team" only collects active contributors. The edit is in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/landscape/analysis/LandscapeAnalysisResults.java`, in `getAllTeams`.

The unmatched-contributor check now also requires `contributor.getContributor().isActive()`. Dormant unmatched contributors are skipped entirely, so their repositories don't get added to the remainder either. Configured teams are untouched, so they keep all members, active or not.

Blank latest-commit dates are already treated as active: `DateUtils.isDateWithinRange` returns true for blank input, and `isActive()` delegates to it. So no extra handling was needed.

Verification: `mvn -o -pl codeanalyzer test` compiled cleanly and reported no failures. However, no test in the repo references `LandscapeAnalysisResults`, so the new filter isn't covered by any test and I didn't exercise it directly. I did not commit.
